assets.name: grunt
assets.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet for ONE original Eclipse grunt character for a classic GBA monster-catching RPG. Transparent background. Crisp pixel art with a restricted 15-color palette, no antialiasing. Charcoal fitted utility uniform, violet shoulder panels and belt, silver crescent badge, dark cap, boots; no letters, no weapons. Sheet layout on a 512x256 canvas: left half contains ONE full-body battle pose facing left, centered in a 256x256 cell with generous transparent margin (intended downsample to64x64). Right half contains a clean 3x3 grid of nine tiny top-down RPG walking sprites in equal cells: first row front facing idle/left step/right step; second row back facing idle/left step/right step; third row left facing idle/left step/right step. Consistent same character proportions and colors, tiny overworld characters intended16x32. No labels or borders. Readable strong silhouette, clean retro pixel clusters.
